mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(char_count), 0) FROM translation_usage WHERE usage_month = #{month}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO translation_usage (usage_month, char_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{month}, #{chars}, #{now}, #{now}) AS n ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE char_count = translation_usage.char_count + n.char_count, updated_at = n.updated_at
